svg.title: How the limits decide whether the AI runs
svg.desc: A new issue, an answer of the reporter or a comment of the reporter after a release asks for a run of the AI. When a maintainer asks, or someone runs the workflow by hand, the AI runs. For everyone else, a comment after a release needs the AI to have read fewer than release_replies comments of the reporter since the release. Then the day needs room: fewer than max_per_day new issues, follow-ups and replies after a release in the 24 hours before. A new issue also needs its reporter to have opened fewer than max_per_author_per_day issues in those 24 hours. Over a limit, the maintainer takes over, and the run notes which limit was reached.
